notes.subject: דוג/דיג · ציד/צד
notes.rationale: fish–fish-for and hunt–hunt-for root pairs: Hebrew repeats one root as verb and noun; TPI has to use two different phrases, losing the echo.

notes.subject: man bilong kukim pis
notes.rationale: לדוגים are 'fishers' catching people like fish; TPI kukim pis is the ordinary word for fishing, not the catching picture itself.

notes.subject: ol man bilong kukim pis na karem abus
notes.rationale: the fishers and hunters are an unexplained image — who they are is left hidden in the verse itself.

translation: Lukluk, mi salim olgeta man bilong kukim pis, Yahwe i tok, na ol bai kukim ⟨את⟩ ol; na bihain long ol dispela, mi bai salim planti man bilong karem abus wantaim hetbilong ol, na ol bai karem ol i kamap, ausait long olgeta maunten, na ausait long olgeta hil, na long ol hole insait long ol ston.

tokens.gloss: man bilong karem abus wantaim hetbilong ol
